kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انسلخت (form VII)
# اِنْسَلَخْتُ (insalaḵtu) /in.sa.lax.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# اِنْسَلَخْتَ (insalaḵta) /in.sa.lax.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# اِنْسَلَخْتِ (insalaḵti) /in.sa.lax.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# اِنْسَلَخَتْ (insalaḵat) /in.sa.la.xat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
